copy.twitter: Stop trying to invent a new theory for your essay. Your professor isn't looking for a Nobel Prize; they’re looking for your ability to synthesize, critique, and justify. Are you writing an argument or just summarizing? Let's talk about it.
copy.facebook:
I see it every semester: brilliant students losing sleep trying to invent an entirely novel theory, only to end up with a grade that doesn't reflect their effort. Here is the reality of how we mark:

THE 54% TRAP: Trying to invent an entirely novel theoretical model from scratch, but only ending up with an unsubstantiated opinion piece.

THE 78%+ REWRITE: Contrasting opposing empirical studies, critiquing their sampling limitations, and synthesizing a justified academic position.

Markers aren't grading your imagination; they are grading your ability to engage with the literature. If you can show us that you’ve read the room, identified the gaps in current research, and built a logical bridge between them, you’re already in the top tier. 

Don't burn yourself out on a myth. If you want a second pair of eyes on your structure before submission, send a message to our postgraduate writing team on WhatsApp at +91 95098 93638. Let’s get your grades back on track.
